units.claim: Domain holds the plain data-shape files in the per-feature models folders. These files import no controller, service or guard files.

citations.quote: This project is written using [NestJS](https://docs.nestjs.com) for the server

citations.query: MATCH (f:File) WHERE f.filePath CONTAINS '/models/' RETURN count(f) AS numerator, count(f) AS denominator

units.claim: Infrastructure is the inner data-access and wiring layer: database, redis, cookie, config and options. Application services call it directly, as in the NestJS preset.

citations.quote: This project is written using [NestJS](https://docs.nestjs.com) for the server

citations.query: MATCH (a:File)-[:IMPORTS]->(b:File) WHERE a.filePath ENDS WITH '.service.ts' AND (b.filePath STARTS WITH 'src/app/database/' OR b.filePath STARTS WITH 'src/app/redis/' OR b.filePath STARTS WITH 'src/app/cookie/' OR b.filePath STARTS WITH 'src/app/config/') RETURN count(*) AS numerator, count(DISTINCT a) AS denominator

units.claim: Application holds the feature service files (*.service.ts) and DTO files, which carry the business logic that controllers call.

citations.quote: This project is written using [NestJS](https://docs.nestjs.com) for the server

citations.query: MATCH (a:File)-[:IMPORTS]->(b:File) WHERE a.filePath ENDS WITH '.controller.ts' AND b.filePath ENDS WITH '.service.ts' RETURN count(*) AS numerator, count(DISTINCT a) AS denominator

units.claim: Presentation holds the controllers, modules and guards, which are the outermost HTTP and DI-wiring entry points.

citations.quote: This project is written using [NestJS](https://docs.nestjs.com) for the server

citations.query: MATCH (a:File)-[:IMPORTS]->(b:File) WHERE a.filePath ENDS WITH '.controller.ts' AND b.filePath ENDS WITH '.service.ts' RETURN count(*) AS numerator, count(DISTINCT a) AS denominator

units.claim: The order is presentation → application → infrastructure → domain. Controllers import services (6 edges) and services import infrastructure (16 edges). No infrastructure file imports a service, controller or guard, and no service file imports a controller, guard or module, so there are 0 violating edges.

citations.quote: This project is written using [NestJS](https://docs.nestjs.com) for the server

citations.query: MATCH (a:File)-[:IMPORTS]->(b:File) WHERE a.filePath ENDS WITH '.service.ts' AND (b.filePath STARTS WITH 'src/app/database/' OR b.filePath STARTS WITH 'src/app/redis/' OR b.filePath STARTS WITH 'src/app/cookie/' OR b.filePath STARTS WITH 'src/app/config/') RETURN count(*) AS numerator, count(DISTINCT a) AS denominator
